## What changed

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List tests and device checks you ran. For UI changes, include a screenshot and the
viewport/device size. Note anything that remains untested.

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `./build.sh --debug`
- [ ] User-visible changes have a line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] No signing credentials, private data, ROMs, or imported copyrighted assets added
